CFML Language Reference: Functions

FindNoCase

Searches a string for a substring without regard to case and returns the position where it first appears.

Category

String functions

Syntax

FindNoCase(substring, string [, start ])

Parameters

substring
The text to look for.
string
The string to search.
start
Optional. Position at which to start searching. Default 1.

Returns

The position of the first occurrence, or 0 if the substring is not found.

Usage

Works exactly like Find except that "Y2K", "y2k" and "Y2k" are all the same to it. A quick way to test whether a word appears at all is FindNoCase(word, text) GT 0.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetCourses" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT CorName FROM CourseList ORDER BY CorName
</CFQUERY>
<P>Courses with "intro" anywhere in the name:</P>
<UL>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetCourses">
<CFIF FindNoCase("intro", CorName)><LI>#CorName# (at position #FindNoCase("intro", CorName)#)</CFIF>
</CFOUTPUT>
</UL>

See also

Find, REFindNoCase, ReplaceNoCase, ListFindNoCase
